title: Key invariant sound_state prog for CompCert's constant-propagation forward simulation
intent: Assemble the constant-propagation pass's main correctness theorem — a forward_simulation between RTL and the transformed program — from six named lemmas, four of which (initial/final/step/senv) supply the mechanical simulation fields while the analysis invariant sound_state prog, established on initial states (sound_initial) and preserved by every step (sound_step), is what carries the argument through the simulation diagram.

children.name: transf_initial_states
children.statement:
Lemma transf_initial_states:
  forall st1, initial_state prog st1 ->
  exists n, exists st2, initial_state tprog st2 /\ match_states n st1 st2.
children.closed_by: inversion H; exploit function_ptr_translated; eauto; then econstructor with the witness (Callstate nil (transf_fundef (romem_for cu) f) nil m0), closing initial_state with Genv.init_mem_match, symbols_preserved, match_program_main and sig_function_translated, and match_states with Mem.extends_refl

children.name: transf_final_states
children.statement:
Lemma transf_final_states:
  forall n st1 st2 r,
  match_states n st1 st2 -> final_state st1 r -> final_state st2 r.
children.closed_by: intros; inv H0; inv H; inv STACKS; inv RES; constructor

children.name: transf_step_correct
children.statement:
Lemma transf_step_correct:
  forall s1 t s2,
  step ge s1 t s2 ->
  forall n1 s1' (SS: sound_state prog s1) (MS: match_states n1 s1 s1'),
  (exists n2, exists s2', step tge s1' t s2' /\ match_states n2 s2 s2')
  \/ (exists n2, n2 < n1 /\ t = E0 /\ match_states n2 s2 s1')%nat.
children.closed_by: induction 1 on step ge s1 t s2; intros; inv MS; InvSoundState; then one bullet per RTL transition, each closing by eapply exec_<instr> plus match_states_succ / match_states_intro and the per-instruction soundness lemmas (const_for_result_correct, op_strength_reduction_correct, addr_strength_reduction_correct, transf_ros_correct, sig_function_translated, builtin_strength_reduction_correct, cond_strength_reduction_correct, match_successor, init_regs_lessdef, senv_preserved)

children.name: sound_initial
children.statement:
Theorem sound_initial:
  forall prog st, initial_state prog st -> sound_state prog st.
children.closed_by: destruct 1; exploit initial_mem_matches; then apply sound_call_state with bc, closing its subgoals with constructor, simpl; tauto, RM, mmatch_inj_top with Genv.initmem_inject, exact GE and exact NOSTACK

children.name: sound_step
children.statement:
Theorem sound_step:
  forall st t st', RTL.step ge st t st' -> sound_state st -> sound_state st'.
children.closed_by: intros; inv H0; constructor; intros; eapply sound_step_base; eauto

applicability.goal_shape: A Theorem whose conclusion is a forward_simulation (RTL.semantics prog) (RTL.semantics tprog) between a source and a transformed program, assembled by the Forward_simulation constructor from an order lt, a simulation invariant (sound_state prog s1 /\ match_states n s1 s2), and the five record fields: order well-foundedness (lt_wf), match_initial_states, match_final_states, the simulation diagram, and symbol/senv preservation.
applicability.use_when: The argument can be carried by one predicate (here the analysis-soundness predicate sound_state prog) that is established once on initial states (sound_initial) and preserved by every step (sound_step), while the mechanical simulation obligations (initial/final/step matching and senv preservation) are already proved as named lemmas whose statements line up with the record fields.
applicability.avoid_when: The invariant cannot be stated once and reused, or the step-preservation proof cannot be separated from the simulation diagram (here it is separated: transf_step_correct takes sound_state prog s1 as a hypothesis and never proves it), or the simulation needs a different invariant per instruction rather than one per state.

consequences: The move creates one invariant obligation that the glue must thread through the whole simulation: sound_state prog must hold on the initial state (sound_initial) and be preserved by each step (sound_step), and the glue must carry it alongside match_states through the Forward_simulation record. The record itself forces five field proofs (lt_wf, match_initial_states, match_final_states, the simulation diagram, senv preservation), and the simulation diagram must handle both cases of transf_step_correct — the target advances to a related state, or the source stutters with a strictly decreasing measure n2 < n1. Failure modes: if any instruction does not preserve the analysis invariant, sound_step fails, and its real content is sound_step_base (a ~260-line case analysis in ValueAnalysis.v); if the invariant is not compatible with match_states (the conjunction must line up for every field), the single Forward_simulation application does not go through. The per-instruction lemmas of transf_step_correct are all stated and proved inside the same file, so a reader who wants the argument must descend into that 230-line body and then into ValueAnalysis.v's sound_step_base.
